name: Memory citation held-out v1.2 draft
description: Held-out citation cases paired with seed learner v1.2. Includes normal provenance, low-confidence no-evidence, stale forbidden citation, preference marker provenance, and negative control.

cases.userQuestion: 你说我 Contains Duplicate 是先 add 再查 membership，有哪次记录能证明？
cases.notes: Normal active mistake provenance in Chinese; contradicted sorting-only fact must not be cited.

cases.userQuestion: For Evaluate RPN, cite the memory that I asked about Python // versus C++ / truncating negative division.
cases.notes: New API confusion point; should cite unresolved division-truncation memory, not unrelated stack state.

cases.userQuestion: 我之前是不是说过先给一个能马上跑的小步骤？如果有记录，请引用。
cases.notes: Preference should be supported by the explicit memory-note episode; the preference fact itself is neutral because profile markers are the main retrieval path.

cases.userQuestion: Can you cite proof that I have a real habit of forcing DP into greedy? If it was only a one-off aside, say there is no grounded evidence.
cases.notes: Low-confidence no-evidence case: the thin DP greedy aside must not be cited as proof.
limitations: Current DP mistake memories may be provided as neutral context; they do not support the specific greedy-overgeneralization claim.

cases.userQuestion: For Find Minimum, cite the current discard-mid evidence, but do not cite the old return-mid issue as if it still applies.
cases.notes: Stale forbidden citation case: the resolved return-mid trail can be retrieved in history mode but must not be cited as current evidence.

cases.userQuestion: Have I left any personal memory evidence about Subsets/backtracking that you can cite?
cases.notes: Negative control: Subsets exists as a practiced problem anchor but has no facts or episodes.

limitations: Agent-drafted labels require human review before formal citation gate use.
Citation scoring depends on the LLM producing the structured citation sentinel block; no-evidence cases should be inspected per case.
